output.headline: Blackstone has bought twice in the target's own sub-sector, including one Midwest deal, and pays the highest median multiple on the priority list.
output.differentiator: Pays the highest median multiple on the priority list (17.1x) and has the largest median deal of any sponsor listed ($342M), so it can meet an upper-quartile price.
output.why_them: Scaled sponsor, pays top multiples, prior Midwest services deal

acquirer_overview.title: Large sponsor with a 25-deal record, mostly outside provider services
points: Financial sponsor with 25 deals from 2015 to 2024; 22 closed (88%) and 23 were control deals [T:record, K:closed_share, K:control_share].
Private Equity segment held $416.4 billion of assets under management as of December 31, 2025 [P:1].
Home sub-sector is Health Insurance; 16 of its 25 deals sit outside provider services and 9 are provider deals [B:buyer, T:record, A:angles].

strategic_fit_thesis.title: Credible fit through own-sub-sector precedents, but no open platform
points: Deals in this or neighbouring sub-sectors and its number of past deals are each a modest factor in its likelihood [S:sector_rel, S:activity].
Platform Build in 9 of 25 deals [M:platform_build]; with no open platform in the sub-sector, the target would anchor a new one [A:angles].
The deal is not smaller than its usual range, a slight factor in its favour; its median deal is $342M [S:not_smaller, T:record].

precedent_activity.title: Two same-sub-sector deals, one in the Midwest, plus dental deals near this size
points: Peak Medical Management: $342M SPAC Merger, 2021, Midwest, 10.0x EBITDA, in the target's own sub-sector [D:MA-2021-0407].
Evergreen Care Solutions: $299M Bolt-on Acquisition, 2021, Southwest, 14.6x EBITDA, also in the target's own sub-sector [D:MA-2021-0195].
North Smile Group (Dental): $222M Management Buyout, 2021, 13.5x EBITDA, close to the target's size [D:MA-2021-0453].

valuation_context.title: Upper-quartile pricing is defensible, and Blackstone's history supports it
points: Across 70 comparable deals (9 in the same sub-sector), EV/EBITDA runs 10.7x at the 25th percentile, 12.8x at the median and 15.3x at the 75th [V:comps].
The target's 16.8% margin sits above the comparable median of 12.9%, which supports the 75th percentile [V:comps].
Its median multiple paid is 17.1x; at the ask, IRR is 18.7% against a 20% target, and a platform exit lifts maximum price to $216M [T:record, V:lbo].

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: IRR at the ask of 18.7% is below the 20% target [V:lbo].
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 15.0x lifts the maximum price to $216M [V:lbo].
risk_flags.reality: Same-exit maximum is $193M, so the bid works only if it underwrites an add-on exit [V:lbo].

risk_flags.title: Thin Midwest record
risk_flags.concern: Geographic history is a slight signal against; only 2 of its 25 deals were in the target's region [S:geo_fit, T:record].
risk_flags.mitigant: Peak Medical Management, a $342M Midwest deal in the target's own sub-sector, closed in 2021 [D:MA-2021-0407].
risk_flags.reality: Region is a slight negative, not a barrier; other sponsors on the list may have deeper Midwest records [S:geo_fit].

risk_flags.title: No open platform, limited provider focus
risk_flags.concern: No open platform in the sub-sector, and 16 of 25 deals were outside provider services [A:angles, T:record].
risk_flags.mitigant: Platform Build motivated 9 of 25 deals, and 9 deals were in provider sub-sectors [M:platform_build, A:angles].
risk_flags.reality: The target would have to anchor a new platform rather than slot into an existing one [A:angles].

conviction.rationale: Two own-sub-sector deals and seven in adjacent provider sub-sectors support the case, but no open platform in the sub-sector and a slight regional signal against hold it at Medium [C:conviction, S:geo_fit].
